inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Disabling User Account Control via registry modifications

native_rule.creator: yugandhar.mocherla@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: This rule detects modifications to the EnableLUA registry value, which is a critical setting for User Account Control (UAC) on Windows systems. Disabling UAC by setting this value to 0 can significantly weaken the security posture of a system, allowing for easier privilege escalation and defense evasion by attackers.
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Disabling User Account Control via registry modifications
native_rule.s1ql: event.category='registry' registry.valueType = 'DWORD' (registry.keyPath contains '\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin' or registry.keyPath contains "\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\EnableLUA" or registry.keyPath contains "\\LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy") registry.value='0' src.process.displayName != 'API\ for\ MDM\ Enrollment' osSrc.process.displayName != 'API\ for\ MDM\ Enrollment'
